purpose.text: Automated workflow to locate an Active Directory user, reset their password, and enforce a password change at next logon.
purpose.quote: Automated workflow to locate an Active Directory user, reset their password, and enforce a password

scope.text: Applies to system operations and authorized agents.
scope.quote: Applies to system operations and authorized agents.

roles.responsibility: Executes Active Directory User Password Reset

steps.action: Locate the user account in Active Directory to verify existence and retrieve object details.
steps.expected_outcome: If command succeeds and returns user object, set variables.user_found = true, else set variables.user_found = false
steps.quote: Locate the user account in Active Directory to verify existence and retrieve object details.

steps.action: Reset the target account password to the specified temporary complex credentials.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.password_reset = true, else set variables.password_reset = false
steps.quote: Reset the target account password to the specified temporary complex credentials.

steps.action: Flag the user account to require password change at next logon.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.change_flagged = true, else set variables.change_flagged = false
steps.quote: Flag the user account to require password change at next logon.
